item.title: Unclear pavement markings for bikes and pedestrians, 24th August
item.description:
The road and pavement markings at the crossing between Featherstone Street and Leonard Street are unclear. Cyclists and pedestrians are required to share a narrow crossing space, but the lack of clear markings makes it difficult to understand how the space should be used. This is leading to overcrowding and potentially unsafe interactions between cyclists and pedestrians travelling in both directions. Clearer markings and separation would help make the crossing safer and easier to navigate.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 73, City Road, Islington, Greater London

item.title: Road Surface in an awful state, 24th August
item.description:
The road surface of the whole of Lavidge Road is in a terrible state. It hasn’t been touched for over 30 years. The top layer has come away exposing the underneath. The road markings are old and faded. How this escaped the most recent ‘selection’ of roads that needs attention, I don’t know. Please put some money into our neglected area. We pay enough council tax.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Lavidge Road, Eltham

item.title: Constant dog fouling, 24th August
item.description:
I'm getting dog owners regularly bringing their dogs to the access alley down the side of my house to let their dogs poo.... It's happening every day by a regular group of lazy neighbours. I've just put up a new fence so cleared all the weeds along my fence line , the dog fouling has gotten worse since. I've tried to be polite and ask them to pick it up when I see them but always get the same response, " I don't have poo bags ! " Or arguments. Thanks kindly Danny Laing. 37 Gordon road.
